text:
sam: Quick share — heatmap for the pricing page shows big dropoff right after the calculator. Thoughts on a quick micro-FAQ + sticky CTA test?

miguel: saw that. users hover calculator but don't click CTA. maybe it's confusing what 'units' mean :thinking_face:

olivia: hypothesis: people treat calculator as demo and think they need to sign up to see savings. micro-FAQ could clarify "how calculator works" + examples.

jess: agree. propose A/B: control vs FAQ panel below calc vs FAQ modal on CTA click. Measure CTR -> signup conversion.

anya: also inbound routing — if calc produces an estimate > $5k/mo, route to AE queue. can we capture that value in lead payload?

sam: yes. lead-bot, can we add field `estimated_monthly` to webhook when a calc result is shared? example payload:

```
POST /webhooks/lead
{
  "email": "...",
  "name": "...",
  "estimated_monthly": 6800,
  "page": "/pricing"
}
```

lead-bot: can do. will add mapping & tag leads with `calc_lead:true`.

miguel: on tier names — folks tested "Launch/Grow/Enterprise" last quarter. we should avoid repeating. new idea: "Starter / Team / Dedicated" — clearer about Dedicated capacity.

jess: rename note recorded. also need comms for webinar: 'How to reduce inference cost with Redwood' — callout to highlight calculator walkthrough + benchmark narrative. live demo to push folks to try calc.

olivia: timeline? we can ship FAQ copy + lead field in 1 week if design + eng align.

sam: timeline sounds good. action items:
- miguel: design micro-FAQ variants and sticky modal by Thu
- jess: wire up A/B test plan + events (pricing_calc_view, pricing_calc_submit, calc_estimate_value)
- olivia: update lead routing docs & set AE threshold
- anya: prep webinar blurb and registration CTA linked to calc

sam: any blockers?

miguel: none from design side. will post comps in #design when ready :eyes:

jess: I'll draft event names and GA/GTM mapping later today.

anya: will sync with sales on AE threshold. if >$7k route immediate, else nurture sequence.

sam: perfect. thanks everyone :rocket:
